sections.theory:
Penalty Shoot

On committing an error deliberately, a penalty shoot will be given to the opposing team from the same place. At the time of the penalty shoot the player will stand 3 metres away.

Free Shoot

On deliberately committing a foul inside the shooting circle, a free shoot will be given to the opposing team.

Shooting

Walking with the ball after receiving the ball is a foul, whereas the player, making one foot the pivot, can move the other foot forward and backward.

Penalty

In the case of this foul the ball will be given to the opposing player at the same place.

Two Lines Cross

No player can throw the ball directly across two lines. If the ball in between touches some player or passes touching the ground, it will not be a foul.

Penalty

In the case of this foul, the ball will be given to the opposing team from where the foul was committed.

Making a goal

When some player passes the ball from above through the ring and no foul has been committed, it will be counted a goal. It is compulsory for the player to be inside the shooting circle.
